title: The Bellwether Revivals
author: Benjamin Wood
description: Two Cambridge students become dangerously obsessed with the idea that music can heal — or kill. A dark, literary thriller about genius, belief, and the line between gift and madness.

title: The Bell Jar
author: Sylvia Plath
description: Sylvia Plath's only novel follows Esther Greenwood, a brilliant young woman who begins to crack under the pressure of expectation — a searingly honest portrait of a mind in crisis, and one of the most important novels of the 20th century.

title: White Nights
author: Fyodor Dostoevsky
description: Over four luminous nights in St. Petersburg, a lonely dreamer meets a young woman waiting for someone who may never return. Dostoevsky's tender novella about longing, fantasy, and what we owe each other.

title: The Midnight Bookshop
author: Amanda James
description: You don't choose the book. The book chooses you. Three strangers — Jo, Adelaide, and Kye — find themselves across the threshold of a magical bookshop, and discover that a single book can rewrite their lives. A cosy, enchanting blend of magical realism and heartfelt storytelling.

title: ஒரு மனிதன் ஒரு வீடு ஒரு உலகம்
author: ஜெயமோகன்
description: ஜெயமோகனின் இந்நாவல் ஒரு சாதாரண மனிதனின் வாழ்க்கையை மையமாகக் கொண்டு, குடும்பம், வீடு, சமூகம் என விரியும் உலகை ஆழமாக ஆராய்கிறது.
